meta.dataset: UCI 395 (Isenkul et al. 2014), Wacom tablet + pen; 15 controls, 62 Parkinson's; no essential tremor, no phone recordings

config.envelope: 1 + 0.3 sin(2 pi fe t + psi), fe ~ U(0.1,0.3) Hz; true pp = pp x median(envelope)

bars.reported_frequency: a trial succeeds only if prominence >= MIN_PROMINENCE (the product shows a frequency) AND |f - f_true| <= 0.5 Hz

MIN_PROMINENCE.rule: smallest value on a 0.25 grid with <=5% of dev un-injected control drawings at or above it

MIN_RHYTHM_PP_MM.rule: 1.25 x the largest pp amplitude of any dev un-injected control drawing, rounded up to 0.05 mm (mm via the assumed 0.204 mm/px tablet scale)

GATE.min_rate_hz.rule: lowest simulated rate at which both E1 bars hold on dev (and at every higher tested rate), x0.95 for timestamp noise in the measured rate

GATE.max_template_dev_mm.rule: 99th percentile of template_dev on synthetic honest dev traces, rounded up to 0.1 mm. SYNTHETIC ONLY: no UCI drawing has a template; untested on real phone drawings

GATE.max_speed_mm_s.rule: largest S such that dev false rhythm (prominence AND amplitude rules) among time-compressed un-injected control drawings passing every other gate check, with speed <= S' for every S' <= S, stays <= 5%; capped at the fastest such drawing; 5 mm/s grid
GATE.max_speed_mm_s.first_run_rule: 20 mm/s windows of injected+un-injected trials, prominence rule only (rejected 51-57% of PD drawings; superseded on orchestrator instruction)

E10_template_gate_synthetic.label: synthetic phone-like traces over the phone template (a=4 mm, b=26/(6 pi) mm/rad, 3 turns): honest = template + constant offset U(-1,1) mm + slow radial wander SD U(0,1.5) mm (<0.6 Hz) + tremor pp U(0,4) mm at U(4,12) Hz, 15% traced from the outer end; 60 Hz, +-2 ms jitter, 0.16 mm quantisation. The honest-trace error model is an assumption, not measured on people.

E3_phone_sampling.label: simulated phone sampling (uniform resample + ±2 ms jitter + 0.16 mm quantisation), not a phone

E4_speed_stress.confound: time compression also shortens the drawing (fewer Welch segments)

E5_baselines.method_radial: Longardner et al. 2024 style radial error (2 Hz zero-phase low-pass of r); frequency from the PSD of the radial residual; pp = pi * mean|e|
E5_baselines.method_zero_cross: zero-crossing rate of the band-passed principal-axis signal

E6_pd_vs_control_exploratory.label: exploratory; 15 controls total; not diagnostic; one value per subject (mean over tests)

E7_static_vs_dynamic.label: between-task (static vs dynamic spiral, same session), not test-retest; a lower bound on test-retest reliability
E7_static_vs_dynamic.reference: Elble & Ellenbogen 2017: tablet spiral pp amplitude ICC 0.97, MDC 51% of baseline over 2 days, 20 ET patients

E8_gate_real_data.note: no printed template exists for UCI, so coverage/off_template are not evaluated; strokes derived from gaps > 50 ms (see LIFT_GAP_MS)

headline.claim: Injected 4–12 Hz tremor ≥1 mm pp on real control drawings: frequency reported within ±0.5 Hz in linear 100%, radial 100%, elliptical 100%.
headline.caveat: synthetic sinusoidal tremor on real tablet drawings; not patient tremor

headline.claim: Amplitude within ±25% of truth (pp ≥1 mm): linear 100%, radial 100%, elliptical 100%.
headline.caveat: mm values assume 0.204 mm/px tablet scale

headline.claim: False 'dominant rhythm' on un-injected healthy drawings: 0/16 (prominence ≥ 9.5 and amplitude ≥ 0.45 mm).
Simulated 60 Hz phone sampling: ±0.5 Hz in 100%, amplitude ±25% in 100% (pp ≥1 mm).
headline.caveat: simulated phone sampling, not a phone; finger/stylus on a real phone untested

headline.claim: Linear-axis tremor vs a radial-only (Longardner-style) baseline: frequency ±0.5 Hz 100% vs 100%; amplitude ratio 0.99 vs 0.65.
headline.caveat: advantage is amplitude, not frequency; same synthetic injections

headline.claim: PD vs control, tremor amplitude AUC 0.82 (95% CI 0.66–0.95).
headline.caveat: exploratory, 8 controls; device clock differs by group; not diagnostic

headline.claim: Static vs dynamic spiral amplitude ICC(2,1) 0.93; MDC95 104% change.
headline.caveat: between-task, not test-retest; Elble 2017 reports MDC 51% test-retest in ET
UCI has no ET patients and no phone recordings
